content:
samir: Heads-up — NebulaTech requests a hosted POC key. Requirements: embeddings-only (write), TTL 48h, rotate after 24h and POST rotation events to their webhook, IP allowlist 52.23.10.0/24, disable telemetry/analytics, billing via partner reseller account. They also want a signed DPA acceptance before we hand off. Can ops provision and confirm rotation+revoke playbook?

felix: Quick clarifying q — embeddings.write scope ok? They explicitly asked no streaming. Any extra token-binding (mTLS) requests from them?

samir: embeddings.write only. No streaming. They mentioned token-binding as an option but said its not required for the demo. Webhook for rotation notifications: https://hooks.nebulatech.com/poc-rotate. They want the secret placed in our shared 1Password path and a short acceptance email recorded in the ticket.

jules: Legal: we need them to sign the DPA addendum for data non-retention. I can send the contract now; please do not hand over the key until we have the signed reply.

mina: Ops: I can provision but will block on signed DPA. Drafting steps for transparency: 
- redwoodctl keys provision --name nebula-nebula-poc --scopes embeddings.write --ttl 48h --allowlist 52.23.10.0/24 --rotation-interval 24h --rotation-webhook https://hooks.nebulatech.com/poc-rotate --telemetry off --billing-account nebula-reseller-123
- redwoodctl keys annotate --name nebula-nebula-poc --note "DPA required; webhook rotation; place secret in 1Password/shared/pocs/nebula"
I will also enable audit-flag to record rotation events in our audit log.

ops-bot: Ticket created: TKT-4482 (nebula hosted key request). Assigned to mina, jules.

felix: For the revoke/rotate playbook (ops copy):
- Rotate: POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
- Revoke: POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
- After rotation, place new secret in 1Password and ping the webhook consumer. Do NOT paste secrets in Slack.

samir: Also add a short customer-facing checklist so sales knows what to expect: signed DPA, 1Password link + who has access, allowlist applied, webhook verified with test ping, billing account attached, key expiry timestamp included. We should include an automatic revoke step if DPA not returned within 72h.

jules: I'll send the DPA now and will update TKT-4482 when signed.

mina: I have everything queued. Will not provision until jules confirms signed DPA in ticket. When done, I'll update the audit record and drop the 1Password link into TKT-4482.

ops-bot: TKT-4482 updated: jules uploaded DPA signed_by@nebulatech.com.

mina: Provisioned: key created with id kj_live_03f4. Secret stored in 1Password/shared/pocs/nebula (link posted to ticket). Rotation scheduled at 24h via webhook. Audit log entry: AUD-98214. I did not post the secret here.

samir: Perfect. Please add a revocation reminder for 48h+6h (grace window) and tag sales for wrap-up.

ops-bot: TKT-4482 updated: mina scheduled revoke reminder + tagged samir.

samir: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
